allowed-model-unknown-child-defaults.jso.reason: a group's child_defaults allow a model that does not exist

allowed-model-unknown-group.json.reason: a group allows a model that does not exist

allowed-models-wildcard-mixed-child-defa.reason: "*" is listed alongside model names in child_defaults

api-key-env-invalid.json.reason: api_key_env must be an environment variable name

api-key-env-kaiak-prefix.json.reason: api_key_env must not name one of the gateway's own KAIAK_ variables (its tokens would reach the backend's URL)

api-key-env-otel-headers.json.reason: api_key_env must not name an OTEL_ variable: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS holds the log export's credentials, which would reach the backend's URL

api-key-env-otel-logs-endpoint.json.reason: the whole OTEL_ prefix is reserved, not only the header variables: an endpoint can carry credentials too

api-key-env-otel-logs-headers.json.reason: api_key_env must not name an OTEL_ variable: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_HEADERS holds the log export's credentials, which would reach the backend's URL

backend-id-invalid.json.reason: IDs start with a letter or digit and hold no spaces

backend-inline-api-key.json.reason: credentials are env-var names only; an inline key is an unknown field

backend-type-unknown.json.reason: backend type must be openai-compatible, openai, azure-openai, vllm or llama-server

backends-as-array.json.reason: collections are objects keyed by ID

base-url-no-scheme.json.reason: base_url must be http or https

base-url-user-only.json.reason: a base URL carries no user name either (a bare token before @ is a credential)

base-url-userinfo.json.reason: a base URL carries no credentials: provider secrets travel only as api_key_env

child-defaults-unknown-field.json.reason: child_defaults holds allowed_models and limits only

control-outage-grace-string.json.reason: control_outage_grace_ms is a number of milliseconds, not a duration string

defaults-best-of.json.reason: best_of is owned by the gateway (it multiplies the output reservation), not a default

defaults-n.json.reason: n is owned by the gateway (it multiplies the output reservation), not a default

defaults-nested-number-out-of-range.json.reason: numbers inside a default's objects and arrays must be finite too

defaults-null-value.json.reason: a null default means nothing; rejected

defaults-number-out-of-range.json.reason: a default's number must be finite as JavaScript reads it (1e400 would become Infinity)

defaults-owned-field.json.reason: the output limit is set through output_limit, not defaults

defaults-service-tier.json.reason: service_tier is owned by the gateway (it keeps every request on standard processing), not a default

defaults-stream.json.reason: stream is the client's choice, not a default

deployment-backend-unknown.json.reason: the deployment's backend does not exist

deployment-duplicate.json.reason: the same deployment is listed once

deployment-model-513.json.reason: a backend model name is at most 512 characters

deployment-model-non-ascii.json.reason: a backend model name is printable ASCII (give the model an alias on the backend)

deployment-model-space.json.reason: a backend model name holds no spaces

deployments-empty.json.reason: a model needs at least one deployment

effective-limits-exceeded.json.reason: 50 001 effective limits, one over the 50 000 bound: 50 global, 50 of the users group's own, and 100 child_defaults limits on each of its 499 children — one child overrides a default (still 100), one adds a limit of its own (101)

expires-at-leap-second.json.reason: expires_at uses a leap second, which neither side accepts

expires-at-not-a-day.json.reason: expires_at names a day that does not exist

expires-at-offset.json.reason: timestamps are UTC with a Z suffix

first-event-timeout-zero.json.reason: the first-event timeout is a positive integer

global-default-user.json.reason: defaults for a group's children live in its child_defaults; global.default_user is an unknown field

group-cycle-self.json.reason: a group names itself as its parent

group-cycle.json.reason: two groups name each other as parent: a path must end at a top-level group

group-depth-exceeded-two-levels.json.reason: a chain of 10 levels: levels 9 and 10 each report their depth (the issue is per group, not per chain)

group-depth-exceeded.json.reason: a group at level 9: a top-level group is level 1, and the tree holds at most 8 levels

group-id-invalid.json.reason: group IDs start with a letter or digit and hold no spaces

group-parent-unknown.json.reason: a group's parent does not exist

group-unknown-field.json.reason: a group has no kind (labels carry what the control plane needs); unknown fields are invalid

groups-as-array.json.reason: groups is an object keyed by group ID

integer-above-int64.json.reason: an integer past what any half holds is refused, not clamped

integer-above-safe.json.reason: config integers stay at or below 2^53 - 1, so both halves read them exactly

key-group-unknown.json.reason: a key names a group that does not exist

key-hash-no-prefix.json.reason: the hash carries the sha256: prefix

key-user-field.json.reason: a key names its group only; user is an unknown field

key-with-allowed-models.json.reason: keys carry no allowed models of their own

key-with-limits.json.reason: keys carry no limits of their own

label-key-too-long.json.reason: label keys are at most 63 characters

label-value-control-char.json.reason: label values hold no control characters

label-value-empty.json.reason: label values hold at least one character

label-value-too-long.json.reason: label values are at most 256 characters

labels-too-many.json.reason: a group has at most 16 labels

limit-duplicate-all-models.json.reason: two all-model limits of one type in the global scope

limit-duplicate-child-defaults.json.reason: two child_defaults limits share type and model set

limit-duplicate-group.json.reason: two of a group's own limits share type and model set (limits the group overrides from its parent's child_defaults do not count)

limit-duplicate-reordered-models.json.reason: two limits in one scope share type and model set (order ignored)

limit-model-unknown-child-defaults.json.reason: a child_defaults limit names a model that does not exist

limit-model-unknown.json.reason: a limit names a model that does not exist

limit-models-empty.json.reason: a limit's model list is omitted for all models, never empty

limit-models-wildcard.json.reason: a limit covers all models by omitting models, not with "*"

limit-requests-fractional.json.reason: request and token limits are integers

limit-type-unknown.json.reason: limit types are the four v1 types

limit-value-above-safe.json.reason: a limit value stays at or below 2^53 - 1

max-in-flight-zero.json.reason: a backend's max_in_flight is at least 1; no cap is an omitted max_in_flight

metrics-unknown-field.json.reason: global.metrics holds only key_id_label and group_label

model-name-props-suffix.json.reason: a model name ending in /props collides with the props endpoint

model-queue-empty.json.reason: a model's queue override sets at least one field

model-queue-size-string.json.reason: a model's queue size is an integer

model-retries-empty.json.reason: a model's retries override sets max_attempts

output-limit-above-context.json.reason: the output-limit ceiling exceeds the context length

output-limit-default-above-ceiling.json.reason: the output-limit default exceeds its ceiling

output-limit-missing-ceiling.json.reason: output_limit needs both default and ceiling

price-cache-write-negative.json.reason: a tokens_cache_write price is not negative

price-date-not-a-day.json.reason: effective_from names a day that does not exist

price-dates-decreasing.json.reason: price entries go back in time

price-dates-equal.json.reason: two price entries share an effective date

price-empty.json.reason: a price entry names at least one unit

price-entry-usd-per-million.json.reason: a price entry lists its prices in tiers; usd_per_million at the entry level is an unknown field

price-reasoning-unit.json.reason: reasoning tokens are part of tokens_out and never priced on their own

price-tier-first-not-zero.json.reason: the first tier starts above 0 tokens, so smaller requests would have no price

price-tier-prices-missing.json.reason: every tier lists its own prices; nothing is inherited from the tier below

price-tier-threshold-above-safe.json.reason: a tier threshold stays at or below 2^53 - 1, as every config integer

price-tier-threshold-fractional.json.reason: a tier threshold is a whole number of tokens

price-tier-threshold-negative.json.reason: a tier threshold is 0 or more

price-tiers-decreasing.json.reason: a tier's threshold is below the one before

price-tiers-empty.json.reason: a price entry has at least one tier

price-tiers-too-many.json.reason: a price entry has at most 8 tiers

price-unknown-unit.json.reason: price units are tokens_in, tokens_cached, tokens_cache_write, tokens_out

queue-size-negative.json.reason: a queue size is 0 or more

queue-timeout-zero.json.reason: a queue timeout is at least 1 ms

queue-unknown-field.json.reason: queue settings hold size and timeout_ms only

reasoning-efforts-without-reasoning.json.reason: reasoning efforts listed for a model without the reasoning capability

response-timeout-string.json.reason: the response timeout is integer milliseconds, not a string

retries-max-attempts-zero.json.reason: max_attempts is at least 1 (the first attempt)

timeout-string.json.reason: durations are integer milliseconds, not strings

unknown-backend-field.json.reason: unknown fields are rejected inside objects

unknown-top-level-field.json.reason: unknown fields are rejected at the top level
